scientific_limitations: Only unit-edge clique metrics obtained by once subdividing at least two vertex-disjoint original edges are treated.
The one-subdivided-edge, adjacent-edge-subdivision and weighted cases are not covered.
Finite spectral checks supplement and do not replace the all-parameter symbolic proof.
Historical priority is assessed by source comparison but not independently certified.
title: A universal negative-type exponent for matching subdivisions of cliques
